items.text: Ravens officially list QB Lamar Jackson questionable for Sunday vs Bengals (high-ankle). Heading in right direction but status undecided.
items.why: Official team listing after limited practice; self-described improvement.
items.implication: GTD; backup implications if sits; Ravens offense shifts.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr (hamstring) OUT Week 7. 49ers DVP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches high. Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson full workload.
items.why: BRob ruled out; SF concedes RB production (White/Holani/Harvey/Love recent).
items.implication: Bijan monopoly on carries/targets/red-zone vs soft DVP.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap/carry share, goal-line, receiving work.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed questionable (calf); DNP Friday after limited Thursday, will test pregame per McVay. Injury believed minor but status up in air. Rapoport confirms.
items.why: Calf felt lack of power/explosion; pregame workout decides.
items.implication: Major target vacuum if OUT; monitor closely.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet headed to IR with season-ending knee injury after being carted off Thursday; coach Ben Johnson confirmed. Schefter corroborates placement on IR.
items.why: Serious knee injury confirmed by coach and sources.
items.implication: Opens TE targets and reduces multi-TE sets for Bears pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining TEs and WRs in 11/12 personnel.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: McVay comments on practice/pregame test; clear target funnel if absent.
items.implication: Higbee primary beneficiary in TE/WR vacuum (Adams already IR).
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for next men up, especially TEs.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK thanks to Caleb Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR PPG, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since.
items.why: Sustained high target share and production with Williams healthy.
items.implication: Start-worthy TE with clear opportunity spike.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: awesome player/scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt. Ignore 'National TE Day' narrative.
items.why: WR injuries create target funnel to Kittle in elite scheme.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets, red-zone, routes with WRs sidelined.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (high-ankle) ruled OUT again this week by coach Mike LaFleur; still trying to get right.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining ARI RBs.

items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.implication: Colts TE targets redistribute; IND pass game adjusts.
items.opportunity: More work for other Colts pass-catchers.

items.text: Berry Loves Week 7: AJ Brown (@CHI), DeVonta Smith (vs DAL), Tucker Kraft (@DET), Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR). Matchup/volume driven; also loves Breece Hall if plays vs MIA.
items.why: Favorable matchups (Bears/Lions soft), high workloads, efficiency.
items.implication: Prioritize in lineups; Hall auto-start if active vs soft MIA.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played just 21% of snaps over the last three weeks. Concerning usage trend.
items.why: Low snap share recent games signals limited role.
items.implication: Avoid or bench until opportunity expands; handcuff value only.

items.text: Berry Hates Week 7: Rome Odunze (vs NE), Josh Downs (@MIN), Travis Kelce (@SEA), Josh Jacobs (@DET), Cam Skattebo (@HOU). Nasty matchups or role/workload concerns.
items.why: Tough defenses, target-share issues, post-layoff questions (Jacobs).
items.implication: Sit or fade; avoid in DFS/start-sit.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 7 rankings live; snaps & pace: TB@CAR up-tempo, MIA@NYJ slow slog. Man vs Machine and survivor notes also available.
items.why: Pace/snaps data for game scripts and volume projection.
items.implication: Adjust projections for high/low pace games; use rankings for start/sit.
items.opportunity: Pace-driven volume edges (e.g. TB/CAR higher plays).
